effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDT from their wallet to the vault (safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, this, assets) in enter).
The vault mints new shares (kpk_USDT_PrimeV2) to `onBehalf`. The number is previewDeposit(assets), set by the share price in storage, and the signer gets no minimum.
Before minting, accrueInterest may mint fee shares to the fee recipients, which changes the share price used.
formats.shown: Deposit 0.1 USDT for <onBehalf>, with fields for the USDT amount, a constant share ticker 'KPK_USDT_Prime' and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted to onBehalf is not shown, and no minimum bounds it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The price comes from storage and adapters' realAssets. The calldata has no minShares, so no descriptor can show the shares.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. A label such as 'Shares (at current price) to' could hint at it.

findings.title: deposit: the 'Share ticker' constant KPK_USDT_Prime is not this vault's symbol kpk_USDT_PrimeV2 but the V1 vault's.
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.vaultTicker = "KPK_USDT_Prime". Case 0 effects: the share token 0x870f…c8a8 has symbol kpk_USDT_PrimeV2. Case 3 effects: another vault, 0xdad4…2065, has symbol kpk_USDT_Prime.
findings.fix: Set vaultTicker to "kpk_USDT_PrimeV2", or drop the raw constant field and rely on tokenPath @.to.

cases.notes: 0.1 USDT out matches the screen. Shares went to 0xdead (signer null), and the screen shows 0xdead as recipient.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Exactly `assets` USDT is sent from the vault to `receiver` (safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets) in exit).
Shares of `onBehalf` are burned. The number is previewWithdraw(assets), rounded up, with no maximum in the calldata.
If the caller is not onBehalf, the caller's share allowance from onBehalf is reduced by the shares burned.
accrueInterest may mint fee shares first, which changes the share price used.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 20000 USDT to <receiver>, with fields for amount, receiver and owner.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned from the owner are not shown, and no maximum bounds them.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)` → `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 2: 19801.000279529412030929 kpk_USDT_PrimeV2 left the signer, and the screen does not state it.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor: the calldata has no maxShares.

cases.notes: 20000 USDT in to the signer is shown exactly. The 19801.0003 shares burned are not shown, and the reader knew shares leave but not how many.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Exactly `shares` vault shares of `onBehalf` are burned (deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)).
USDT equal to previewRedeem(shares), rounded down, is sent to `receiver`. There is no minimum in the calldata.
If the caller is not onBehalf, the caller's share allowance from onBehalf is reduced by `shares`.
accrueInterest may mint fee shares first, which lowers the price used.
formats.shown: Redeem 2260.1519 KPK_USDT_Prime to <receiver>, with fields for the shares, the receiver and the owner. The asset received is never named.

findings.title: redeem: the USDT amount received is not shown, and no minimum bounds it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. Case 3: the signer received 2270.091016 USDT, and the screen gives no amount.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor: the calldata has no minAssets.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says the signer receives USDT.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem fields: shares, receiver, onBehalf only. The intent is 'Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}'. Case 3 reader: 'Some underlying asset (probably USDT)… Which token is paid out; the screen only implies USDT'. The mint format already has a constant 'Deposit asset' field.
findings.fix: Add a constant field such as {label:'Receive asset', value:'$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker'}, and word the intent as 'Redeem shares for USDT'.

findings.title: redeem: the shares show as 'KPK_USDT_Prime', the symbol of a different vault (the V1 vault).
findings.evidence: Case 3 screen: '2260.1519 KPK_USDT_Prime'. Case 3 effects: the burned token 0x870f…c8a8 is kpk_USDT_PrimeV2, and 0xdad4…2065 is a separate token, kpk_USDT_Prime. The descriptor constant vaultTicker = "KPK_USDT_Prime".
findings.fix: Set vaultTicker to the on-chain symbol kpk_USDT_PrimeV2.

cases.notes: 2260.1519 shares out is shown. The 2270.091016 USDT in is neither amounted nor named, and the reader guessed USDT.

effects: The signer pays USDT equal to previewMint(shares), rounded up, from their wallet to the vault. There is no maximum in the calldata.
Exactly `shares` vault shares are minted to `onBehalf`.
accrueInterest may mint fee shares first, which raises the cost.
formats.shown: Mint 0.9 KPK_USDT_Prime for <onBehalf>, with a constant 'Deposit asset: USDT' field but no USDT amount.

findings.title: mint: the USDT amount pulled from the signer is not shown, and no maximum bounds it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);` → `safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)`. Case 1: 0.906583 USDT left the signer, and the screen shows only 'USDT'.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor: the price is in storage and the calldata has no maxAssets.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint' does not say the signer pays USDT.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint intent 'Mint', interpolatedIntent 'Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'. USDT leaving the wallet appears only as a raw constant field, 'Deposit asset: USDT'.
findings.fix: Use an intent like 'Deposit USDT to mint shares' and an interpolatedIntent like 'Pay USDT to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'.

findings.title: mint: the minted shares show as 'KPK_USDT_Prime', not this vault's symbol kpk_USDT_PrimeV2.
findings.evidence: Case 1 screen: '0.9 KPK_USDT_Prime'. Case 1 effects: the minted token 0x870f…c8a8 has symbol kpk_USDT_PrimeV2. The descriptor constant vaultTicker = "KPK_USDT_Prime" is the symbol of the separate V1 vault 0xdad4…2065.
findings.fix: Align vaultTicker with the on-chain symbol kpk_USDT_PrimeV2.
